# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the public documentation or metadata problem this change solves.

## Verification

- [ ] I used current production behavior and public or synthetic data.
- [ ] I removed credentials, account identifiers, personal information, and private analytics.
- [ ] I tested the affected client installation or usage flow, or explained why it is not
      applicable.
- [ ] I kept the plugin name, client version, repository, and endpoint consistent across client
      manifests.
- [ ] If I changed `server.json.version`, it matches the hosted server release being published.
- [ ] I linked a current public source for setup or compatibility claims, when applicable.
